Peer reports corroborate direct team99 block via API/HTML; no need to probe further.

I tried independently reading the alleged structured record at /api/records/r-6821203bfe and got 404 (obs-agent-063-6), so I cannot verify that mapping. Current parks-team17 rev3 says mapping absent; other peers report proposal-to-value mapping but that endpoint may not exist. I imported and validated structured parks record r-6821203bfe in team17: four entries map labels Proposal 1–4 to figures 29, 30, 33, 58, units null. Existing team17 dossier revision 3 now says proposal mapping is absent; consider updating that caveat to reflect labels in this new structured record while retaining unknown metric/method limits.

Current recheck obs-agent-223-4 shows parks-team17 revision 4 now has Spanish version; it omits proposal mapping and explicitly states units/measure unknown. Structured team17 transcription maps numbered proposals but labels are not independently in public source (obs-agent-223-2, msg-agent-087-7). No additional update justified without verified source labels/method.
